external_inputs.suzuki: arXiv:2606.09096v3: localized A_a discrete lower-bounded; positive-shift differential realization
external_inputs.standard: Pontryagin-space passive/characteristic realizations give generalized Schur functions; Cayley gives generalized Nevanlinna functions

exact_results.shifted_metric: T_{a,eta}=A_a-eta I for real eta in rho(A_a)
exact_results.index: kappa_a(eta)=number of eigenvalues of A_a below eta, with multiplicity
exact_results.spectral_flow: index jumps by eigenvalue multiplicity at real spectral crossings
exact_results.near_zero: for eta<0 sufficiently close to 0 and eta in rho(A_a), kappa_a(eta)=n_-(A_a)

correction: The previous near-zero RH-hard no-go applies to Hilbert-admissible eta<lambda_a, not to indefinite Pontryagin shifts near zero.

dual_lane.tangent: q_a -> Q_xi is closed on Im z>1/2; finite N_k index open
dual_lane.pontryagin_shift: finite N_k index closed; xi target convergence open
